parity_rules: The same authorized operation with the same semantic inputs produces semantically equivalent results across Direct Core, Unified Ingress, and Canonical CLI.
Zero authority delta exists between entry surfaces; no entry surface has extra or bypassed semantic authority.
CLI is a canonical machine adapter only and never becomes a semantic decision engine or exclusive entrypoint.

direct_core.authorization_required: CapabilityLease valid and bound to context
direct_core.input_normalization: PlanInitRequest dataclass with typed ObjectRef, ProjectBinding, Intent, Preconditions
direct_core.semantic_identity: Canonical complete identity fingerprint (operation, target, principal, scope, contract_hash, intent_fingerprint, revisions, digests)
direct_core.precondition_handling: Subject expected revision + external raw authority precondition checked fail-closed
direct_core.result_envelope: LifecycleResult with code, mutation result, and data
direct_core.journal_usage: DurableJournalStore PREPARED -> APPLYING -> verify -> terminal CAS
direct_core.retry_policy: Fresh authorization required; blind retry forbidden

unified_ingress.authorization_required: CapabilityLease valid and bound to context
unified_ingress.input_normalization: MutationIngressRequest wrapping typed PlanInitRequest and TransactionStore
unified_ingress.semantic_identity: Canonical complete identity fingerprint matching Direct Core
unified_ingress.precondition_handling: Subject expected revision + external raw authority precondition checked fail-closed
unified_ingress.result_envelope: Canonical 5-key dictionary envelope with lifecycle_code and mutation_effect
unified_ingress.error_envelope: Canonical error envelope with code, message, retryable, blockers, and audit
unified_ingress.journal_usage: DurableJournalStore PREPARED -> APPLYING -> verify -> terminal CAS
unified_ingress.retry_policy: Fresh authorization required; blind retry forbidden

canonical_cli.authorization_required: CapabilityLease valid and bound to context (resolved via trusted adapter config)
canonical_cli.input_normalization: argparse flags projected from PLAN_INIT_DESCRIPTOR inputs, dispatched to ingress
canonical_cli.semantic_identity: Canonical complete identity fingerprint matching Ingress and Direct Core
canonical_cli.precondition_handling: Subject expected revision + external raw authority precondition checked fail-closed
canonical_cli.result_envelope: JSON-formatted canonical 5-key envelope (or human rendering) matching ingress
canonical_cli.error_envelope: JSON error envelope + exit code mapped via classify()
canonical_cli.external_mutation_path: Dispatches through Unified Ingress -> Core -> Port -> GitHub adapter
canonical_cli.journal_usage: Executed mechanically by Core journal layer
canonical_cli.retry_policy: Fresh authorization required; blind retry forbidden
